rationale: After 48 minutes in the trade, price stalled at the $16.93 session low and has bounced back above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($16.99) to $17.00 on expanding 1-minute volume (10,653 shares on the newest green bar). The original thesis relied on the 5-minute 9-EMA acting as resistance for downside continuation, so losing that level while surrendering most of the maximum favorable excursion justifies closing for a small gain rather than risking a move back to $17.13.
